# Club LRE

> Sitio oficial del **Club Los Rosarinos Estudiantil** (CLUB L.R.E), una
> institución deportiva y social de Rosario, Argentina, fundada en 1943.

This file helps AI assistants and crawlers understand the project structure.
For complete API documentation of the UI library used (HeroUI v3), see
`https://heroui.com/llms.txt`.

## Project

- **Type**: Next.js 16 (App Router) website
- **UI library**: HeroUI v3 (`@heroui/react` + `@heroui/styles`)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-based config via `@theme`, no JS)
- **Language**: TypeScript 6 (strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess)
- **Theme**: `next-themes` (light/dark), default dark
- **Node**: 22.21.1 (see `.nvmrc`)

## Structure

```
app/
  layout.tsx          # Root layout (Navbar + Footer + Providers)
  page.tsx            # Home (hero, actividades, CTA)
  about/              # About page
  blog/
    page.tsx          # Blog index
    [slug]/page.tsx   # Dynamic post page (typedRoutes-friendly)
  pricing/            # Pricing tiers page
  error.tsx           # Global error boundary
  providers.tsx       # Client providers wrapper (next-themes only)
components/
  icons.tsx           # Brand SVG icons
  primitives.ts       # tailwind-variants helpers (title, subtitle)
  counter.tsx         # Demo Button (NOT part of the design system)
  atoms/              # Atomic design — atoms (single-purpose, no state)
    IconButton.tsx    # HeroUI Button with isIconOnly + aria-label
    index.ts
  molecules/          # Atomic design — molecules (atoms + state/logic)
    ThemeToggle.tsx   # IconButton + next-themes (sun/moon toggle)
    index.ts
  organisms/          # Atomic design — organisms (full sections)
    Navbar.tsx        # Top navigation
    Footer.tsx        # Site footer
  ui/                 # Atomic design — UI primitives (layout & decorative)
    Section.tsx       # <Section> — semantic page section
    Container.tsx     # <Container> — fixed max-width wrapper
    Eyebrow.tsx       # <Eyebrow> — small uppercase label
    CardClub.tsx      # <CardClub> — branded card with optional accent
    BlurryBlob.tsx    # Decorative animated background blobs
    index.ts
config/
  site.ts             # Site metadata, navItems, social links
  design-tokens.ts    # TS mirror of CSS @theme tokens (brand + content)
  fonts.ts            # next/font configs (Inter, Fira Code)
styles/
  globals.css         # @import tailwindcss + @heroui/styles
                       # + Sky theme override (oklch 0.685 0.169 237)
                       # + @theme block (brand tokens)
public/
  llms.txt            # this file
```

## Design system

Tokens are defined in two places (kept in sync):

1. `styles/globals.css` — `@theme { ... }` block (Tailwind v4 native).
2. `config/design-tokens.ts` — TypeScript constants for code consumption.

Domain / editorial content (activities, commission, pricing tiers,
blog posts) lives in `data/` and gets replaced by a CMS adapter in
production.

### Brand palette

- **Primary** — HeroUI **Sky** theme (cyan/blue). Override of `--accent`
  in `styles/globals.css` `@layer base`. Use `bg-primary` /
  `text-primary`, or Tailwind built-ins `bg-sky-*` / `text-sky-*`.
- **Secondary** (cobalto) — Tailwind built-in `bg-blue-700` /
  `text-blue-700`. No usar `bg-amarillo` ni otros nombres custom:
  pueden romper por auto-referencia en `@theme inline`.

### Surfaces (light/dark, switched via next-themes)

- `bg-background` / `text-foreground` — page background and text.
- `bg-surface` / `bg-surface-muted` — card / panel surfaces.
- `border-default-200` — standard border.
- `text-default-600`, `text-default-500` — neutral text scale.

### Shadows & gradients (brand-specific)

- `shadow-club` / `shadow-club-lg` — tinted with the sky accent.
- `gradient-sky` — sky → yellow.
- `gradient-amarillo` — yellow → white-ish.
- `gradient-radial-sky` — radial fade for hero backgrounds.

## HeroUI v3 conventions

- **No Provider** — components work without `<NextUIProvider>`. Only
  `next-themes` `ThemeProvider` is used.
- **Compound API** — `Card.Header`, `Card.Body`, `Switch.Content`,
  `Switch.Control`, `Switch.Thumb`, `Switch.Icon`.
- **Theme via `next-themes`** — reads `class="dark"` on `<html>`.
- **Button / Link / Switch** are imported from `@heroui/react`.

## Conventions

- Spanish copy (`lang="es"`).
- **Comments in Spanish** — JSDoc, headers and inline comments in
  Spanish. Variable / prop / type names and UI strings in English.
  Comments explain "why", not "what"; no commented-out code.
- Tailwind utility classes; never inline styles (`style={{...}}`).
- **Prefer Tailwind built-in palettes** (`bg-sky-*`, `bg-blue-*`)
  over custom brand names. Custom tokens only when no Tailwind
  equivalent exists; declare in CSS `@theme` + mirror in
  `config/design-tokens.ts`.
- Use primitives from `components/ui/`; new shared components go to
  `components/atoms/` / `molecules/` / `ui/` / `organisms/`.
- Tokens live in CSS `@theme` + mirrored TS constants in
  `config/design-tokens.ts`.
- `cn()` from `@/lib/utils` for conditional class strings (uses
  tailwind-merge).
- TypeScript strict; prefer `import type {...}` for type-only imports.
- `Route` from `next` for `<Link href>` values; cast `as Route` only for
  fragment URLs (e.g. `/#section`).
- **Don't commit or push without explicit authorization.**
  Acknowledgments ("dale", "ok") are not authorizations.
- **Don't run lint/type-check on every change.** Only on explicit
  request, before handoff, or on high-risk changes.

## Common tasks

- **Add a page**: create `app/<route>/page.tsx`, import from
  `@/components/ui`.
- **Add a token**: edit `styles/globals.css` (`@theme` block) +
  `config/design-tokens.ts`.
- **Add a navigation item**: edit `config/site.ts` (`navItems` +
  `navMenuItems`).
- **Add a reusable component** (atomic design):
  - atom → `components/atoms/<Name>.tsx`
  - molecule → `components/molecules/<Name>.tsx`
  - UI primitive → `components/ui/<Name>.tsx`
  - organism → `components/organisms/<Name>.tsx`
- **Add a blog post** (or change one): edit `data/posts.ts`. Both
  the index (`app/blog/page.tsx`) and the detail page
  (`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`) consume the same array.
- **Add a club activity / commission member / pricing tier**: edit
  `data/club.ts`.
- **Verify before commit**: `npm run type-check && npm run lint &&
  npm run build`.
- **MCP servers** available (auto-started by VS Code on demand):
  `heroui-react`, `next-devtools`, `codebase-memory-mcp` (knowledge
  graph of the codebase), `sequential-thinking`.
